accuracy: New units M-C-26–47 and M-V-01 were read continuously against Rafed displayed pp.162–195 and 198–199. Displayed page labels are distinguished from unverified physical-pagination mappings. The p.169 image was visually transcribed; the defective p.193 digital table has an explicitly editorial English reconstruction. Targeted 1968 facsimile checks of the table and final examples support the table alignment, one complement mark, the division equation and the matching verb; one complement restoration remains conjectural. The full 1968 text remains uncollated. Earlier selection gaps, omitted charts, normalized M-K-14 and unresolved symbolic readings remain disclosed. Stage IX completes the working Book V translation through displayed p.270: 798/798 source blocks in the new span, 39 new units, 17,441 English body words. Nine source-supported English decisions and the recovered classification figure are distinguished from four unresolved printed cruxes. The 1968 visual checks remain targeted; complete independent print collation is not claimed.
